visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Five women in shimmering silver sequined floor-length dresses are positioned in a studio setting with a dark gray textured wall. One woman is seated in the center playing a cello, while the others stand around her, two on each side, playing violins and a flute. (2) The camera transitions between a medium group shot and closer individual shots, showing the performers' smiling faces and focused hand movements on their instruments. The lighting is soft and warm, highlighting the texture of their dresses. (3) The performers continue their synchronized musical movements, with the flute player in the upper right and violinists on the flanks. The composition remains balanced and centered on the cellist. (4) The video concludes with a final group shot where the musicians finish their performance, looking directly into the camera with graceful expressions as the scene fades slightly.

(5) [Subtitle]: Everyone locked in, each part in perfect sync. 每位樂手專業的找到和聲, 效率既快又完美同步. (6) [Subtitle]: Music meets the elegant dress ✨. 搭上今晚演出的禮服簡直完美! audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-fidelity instrumental recording begins with a bright flute melody supported by a rhythmic string section. The tempo is upbeat and steady at approximately 120 BPM. The strings provide a clean, staccato backing while the flute maintains a lyrical, airy presence. (2) The acoustic texture remains pure with a high signal-to-noise ratio. The interplay between the violin's higher harmonics and the cello's resonant lower frequencies creates a full spectral balance. There are no vocal interruptions or electronic effects. (3) The performance reaches its final cadence. The instruments synchronize for a conclusive major chord that is sustained for a brief second before a clean, abrupt silence. A subtle mechanical click or shuffling sound is audible at the very end.
